区分桥梁优惠与快速车道规则，并核对六座桥的 2026 年设备调整。: Separate bridge discounts from express lane rules and check the 2026 tag changes on six bridges.
FasTrak：车牌账户与短期付款: FasTrak: license plate accounts and short-term payments
普通及短期车牌账户用于桥费，不适用于 Express Lanes。: Regular and short-term license plate accounts pay bridge tolls and do not apply to express lanes.
确认租车公司方案、服务费、设备及车辆登记起止日期。: Check rental-company plans, service fees, tags, and the vehicle registration start and end dates.
官方不通过带网站链接的短信要求付款；从官方入口独立核验。: FasTrak does not request payment through texts containing website links; verify independently through the official site.
导航里出现 FasTrak，只说明路上有收费点：整条高速未必都收费，有账户也不会: Seeing FasTrak in navigation only means there is a toll point on the way: the whole freeway isn’t necessarily tolled, and an account doesn’t automatically give you carpool discounts. Separate which bridge you will cross from whether you choose an express lane, then check the vehicle and payment method. Ask especially with a rental: bridge toll service may not cover Express Lanes, and asking at pickup is easier than untangling charges later.
先区分桥费与可选的快速车道: First distinguish bridge tolls from optional express lanes
过桥：按桥名、方向与车辆类别查。金门桥只向进入旧金山的南向收桥费，现场不收现金；: Bridges: check the named bridge, direction, and vehicle category. The Golden Gate Bridge charges southbound into San Francisco and does not take cash at the bridge. Use FasTrak’s bridge directory for other crossings.
快速车道：普通车道仍是选择；进入前看目的地、即时价格与营运时段，按标线进出，不为: Express lanes: general-purpose lanes remain an option. Read destinations, current tolls, and operating periods before entering, and use permitted lane markings; do not cross double white lines to reach an exit.
两种收费分开算：路牌上不同目的地的价格不用相加；高速路段的合乘优惠也套不到收费桥: The two toll types are separate: don’t add up the prices for different destinations on one toll sign, and express lane carpool discounts don’t carry over to bridges.
账户、设备与合乘条件是三件事: Account, tag, and carpool eligibility are separate checks
普通或短期车牌账户只能付桥费，走不了快速车道。上快速车道前，要有有效的 FasT: Regular or short-term license plate accounts can only pay bridge tolls and don’t give express lane access. Before using an express lane you need a valid FasTrak account and a suitable tag; carpool discounts require setting the Flex to the right number of people. Occupancy rules vary: when checked, two-person carpools were free on I-580, while ordinary two-person vehicles paid half price on US-101, subject to tag requirements. For bridges, separately check occupancy, hours, designated lanes, and tags; the six state-owned bridges changed their rules in 2026, so old habits no longer apply.
自有车查登记，租车先问代付范围: Check vehicle registration and rental-plan coverage
自有车先查账户状态、车牌与发牌州，并按官方说明安装设备。租车先问代付是否涵盖桥梁: For your own car, check account status, the plate and issuing state, and mount the tag as instructed. Ask a rental company whether its plan covers bridges and express lanes, what service fees apply, and how to opt out if paying yourself. With your own FasTrak, register the rental plate and accurate start and end dates, update extensions, and remove the tag on return. For bridge-only trips, check short-term plate options and deadlines. Pay an existing invoice through the invoice-payment route; opening a new account is not a substitute.
出发前检查，收到账单后独立核验: Check before driving and verify notices independently
FasTrak 明确不通过附网站链接的短信催你付款。收到“今天到期”等消息，先手: FasTrak explicitly does not request payment through texts with website links. If a message says payment is due today, manually open bayareafastrak.org to check records or contact official support, rather than entering payment details through the text. Compare travel dates, the bridge or lane, and your rental period; use the official inquiry route for discrepancies.
分别列出收费桥和可能使用的快速车道。: List toll bridges separately from any express lanes you may use.
按出行日期查营运时段与人数条件，不默认周末都免费。: Check operating periods and occupancy rules for your date; do not assume all weekends are free.
出发前查好车牌登记、设备安装和人数档位。: Before driving, check plate registration, tag mounting, and the occupancy setting.
租车问清代付范围、服务费与登记结束日期。: For rentals, ask about coverage, service fees, and the registration end date.
保存官方入口，账单查询与付款都独立进入官网。: Save the official site and access it independently for billing questions and payments.
